subject: Instructor reward passcodes — split and distribution plan
messages:
From: Sarah Nolan <sarah@catalyst-academy.org>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partners@catalyst-academy.org
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Instructor reward passcodes request for Dec 8 webinar

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for hosting Catalyst Academy's partner webinar on Dec 8. We want to provide small thank-you rewards to the guest instructors: 75 total single-use trial passcodes (10-day trial) to distribute to three instructor tiers. Can Redwood provision the codes and confirm redemption window and expiration?

Proposed split (flexible):
- Lead instructors: 20 codes
- Guest speakers: 30 codes
- Workshop TAs: 25 codes

Requirements:
- Codes must be single-use and unique per recipient
- Redemption window: Dec 1–Jan 15
- Ability to flag codes for reporting in case of misuse (billing should be marked as marketing/promo)

We need the codes delivered to our partner contact (partners@catalyst-academy.org) by EOD Nov 30. Let me know if that timeline works and if you need anything from our side.

—Sarah Nolan
Partnerships Manager | Catalyst Academy
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Nolan <sarah@catalyst-academy.org>, partners@catalyst-academy.org
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Instructor reward passcodes request for Dec 8 webinar

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding Sarah's ask from Catalyst. Short timeline (EOD tomorrow). Can we:
1) Confirm we can create 75 single-use trial passcodes with a Dec 1–Jan 15 redemption window?
2) Provide a simple CSV with code, tier, expiration, and an internal flag column ("promo_pool: catalyst_dec8") for reporting?
3) Confirm billing treatment as marketing promo credits (so we don't bill the customer)?

Laura — looping you in for compliance/audit logging requirements.

If this is doable, Ben can generate the codes and I can deliver the CSV to Sarah. Please reply with "approved" or "need changes".

Thanks —
Jonas
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Nolan <sarah@catalyst-academy.org>, partners@catalyst-academy.org
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Instructor reward passcodes request for Dec 8 webinar

Approved. We can do 75 single-use codes. Attached is the allocation CSV with the structure we typically use: code, tier_label, expiry_date, promo_pool, internal_note.

Key details:
- Allocation (final): Lead instructors 18, Guest speakers 32, Workshop TAs 25 (small adjustment to match rounding).
- Expiration: 2027-01-15T23:59:00Z
- Redemption window: 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-15
- Billing: mark as "marketing_promo" in billing metadata; count against marketing promo budget for Q4.
- Audit: Laura, please confirm retention policy — we will store the CSV in the partner S3 bucket for 90 days and also push an entry to the promo audit log with the promo_pool tag.

Attachment: passcodes_batch_allocations_20261129.csv (CSV: code,tier_label,expiry_date,promo_pool,internal_note)

Ben, can you generate the single-use tokens with the prefix CATL8- and upload to the partner S3 path below? Also include a short confirmation email we can send to instructors with redemption instructions.

Marissa Cole
Director, Growth Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Nolan <sarah@catalyst-academy.org>, partners@catalyst-academy.org
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Instructor reward passcodes request for Dec 8 webinar

All set — I generated 75 single-use codes and uploaded the allocation CSV to the partner bucket.

Delivery details:
- S3 link (partners): https://s3-redwood.internal/partners/catalyst/passcodes/20261129.csv
- Filename: passcodes_batch_allocations_20261129.csv
- Code format: CATL8-XXXXX (unique)
- Expiry: 2027-01-15T23:59:00Z
- Promo tag: catalyst_dec8 (billing label: marketing_promo)

I've also added a promo_audit entry: audit_id=promo-20261129-catalyst (internal tracking). Laura, let me know if you need the audit payload posted to a different system.

Suggested instructor note (short):
"Thank you for joining Catalyst Academy's Dec 8 webinar. Please use this single-use access code to try Redwood Inference for a 10-day trial: <CODE>. Redeem between Dec 1 and Jan 15. If you have any trouble, contact partners@catalyst-academy.org."

If nobody objects, I'll send the CSV to partners@catalyst-academy.org and cc Jonas.

—Ben Carter
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Nolan <sarah@catalyst-academy.org>
To: partners@catalyst-academy.org, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Instructor reward passcodes request for Dec 8 webinar

Perfect — thank you so much, team. The S3 link works and the CSV looks good. We'll distribute codes to instructors tomorrow morning and include the suggested note. One small ask: can you confirm we should instruct instructors to redeem the code on the hosted Redwood demo flow (hosted.redwoodinference.com/demo) rather than self-hosted instances? That helps our tracking.

If that's correct, please proceed with final delivery to partners@catalyst-academy.org. Appreciate the quick turnaround!

—Sarah
Partnerships Manager | Catalyst Academy
